knowledge_graph.title: B & C Fire Safety
knowledge_graph.type: Fire protection service in Wright, Florida
knowledge_graph.description: Family-run supplier of fire protection equipment, including sprinkler and alarm systems, plus installation and inspection services.
knowledge_graph.address: 823 Navy St, Fort Walton Beach, FL 32547
knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "B&C Fire Safety, based in Fort Walton Beach, Florida, is a family-run business specializing in comprehensive fire protection services and products for commercial, industrial, residential, hospitality, and defense sectors, plus local, state, and federal governments. Services include designing, installing, inspecting, and maintaining fire sprinkler and alarm systems, portable extinguishers, and suppression systems. With additional offices in Santa Rosa Beach and Panama City Beach, B&C covers the Florida panhandle from Pensacola to Tallahassee. Celebrating 50 years, the company continues to experience rapid growth."

posts.description:
☀️ Summer's here! Time to ensure your fire safety systems can handle the heat.
High temperatures can affect equipment performance.

Fire safety protects more than your building—it protects your people, your purpose, and your peace of mind.
Regular maintenance of alarms and sprinklers helps ensure you're always ready.

Florida heat is here.
Check your alarms, extinguishers, and suppression systems.
Book your summer check-up now

From paint booths to server rooms, we install and inspect both Pre-Engineered and Engineered fire suppression systems.
Need a new system—or your 6-month inspection?

From Perdido Key to Tallahassee—we’ve got Northwest Florida covered.
See if we serve your area.

Kitchen fires don’t wait. Neither do our hood systems.
Book a service or install today

📍 We’ve officially opened our doors in Panama City Beach!
For over 50 years, B&C Fire Safety has been protecting lives and property across Northwest Florida. Now, with our newest location right here in PCB, we’re even better positioned to serve the people and businesses who make this community home.
Whether you manage a high-rise condo, run a busy restaurant, or just want to make sure your building is fire-safe, our team is here to help.
👉 Take a look at our new space and explore the services we offer in Panama City Beach.

When was the last time your extinguisher was checked?
If you’re not sure, it’s time.
🧯 Schedule your inspection today.

Security is part of safety.
We install camera systems, access control, and alarms to protect your business from more than just fire.
Ready to upgrade your security? Contact us.

❌MYTH: All sprinklers activate during a fire.
✔️FACT: Sprinklers are designed to activate individually, based on heat detection in specific areas.
That means fires are contained quickly, without unnecessary water damage to the rest of your property.
At B&C Fire Safety, we install and maintain systems that work as intended, stopping fires without causing extra damage.
